paper_id: FedRDMA_ Communication-Efficient Cross-Silo Federated LLM via Chunked RDMA Transmission
title: FedRDMA: Communication-Efficient Cross-Silo Federated LLM via Chunked RDMA Transmission
motivation: RDMA在WAN上因丢包导致重传循环而失效，无法直接用于跨数据中心联邦学习通信
problem_framing: 将RDMA在WAN环境下的传输失效问题重新定义为应用层流量控制问题
key_insight: 通过分块顺序发送限制链路上同时存在的数据量，将burst流量平滑化以适应WAN
method_signature: FedRDMA分块传输 + FedRDMA-E大页池与反向接收策略
evaluation_criteria: 端到端通信时间减少比例 vs TCP/IP基准，含PEFT兼容性和系统能耗
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: RDMA在WAN上运行带宽极低，无法充分利用可用带宽，一旦丢包即陷入无尽重传导致传输失败
evidence_for_taste: communication time still constitutes a substantial 44.97%
RDMA struggles on WANs, operating only at very low bandwidths
creating a vicious cycle that causes RDMA to fall into endless retransmissions
performance degradation caused by all these additional overheads is significant
We are the first to integrate RDMA into federated learning
thinking_moves: 从RDMA在WAN丢包重传失败的现象，反推其根因为大流量burst冲击中间节点缓存容量
将通信优化问题从网络层重框架为应用层流量整形问题，通过分块消除burst
在基本分块方案引入额外CPU开销后，进一步优化为内存池加反向接收策略以消除延迟
cites_own_work: FedLLM (Efficient federated learning for modern NLP)
